title: Studio³ design decision file
description: Persisted output of the Design Intelligence Engine (`studio3 design generate`). Validated structurally by this schema and semantically (contrast, monotonic scales, token references) by `studio3 design validate`.

productCategory.description: Product category, free text (e.g. saas, fintech, portfolio).

overrides.description: User/agent overrides mirroring any section; deep-merged over generated values and preserved by `generate --merge`.
